plain_english: This action-natured power of Śiva, residing in the bound soul, binds while remaining on its own path, known as giving siddhi and more.
sanskrit_cite: seyaṃ kriyātmikā śaktiḥ śivasya paśuvartinī bandhayitrī svamārgasthā jñātā siddhyupadādikā

plain_english: Confined by the eight-city residing in mind, I, and buddhi, cognition arises from that state.
sanskrit_cite: tanmātrodayarūpeṇa mano'haṃbuddhivartinā puryaṣṭakena saṃruddhaḥ tadutthaṃ pratyayodbhavam

plain_english: The dependent soul enjoys and transmigrates from that state; therefore we declare the cause of this transmigration and dissolution.
sanskrit_cite: bhuṅkte paravaśaḥ bhogaṃ tadbhāvāt saṃsaraty ataḥ saṃsṛtipralayasya asya kāraṇaṃ saṃpracakṣmahe

plain_english: When rooted in one place, dissolution and rise are restrained, enjoyership is attained, and then one becomes lord of the wheel.
sanskrit_cite: yadā tu ekatra saṃrūḍhaḥ tadā tasya layodayau niyacchan bhoktṛtām eti tataḥ cakreśvaraḥ bhavet

plain_english: I bow to that beautiful guru speech, varied in meaning, a boat crossing the deep ocean of doubt.
sanskrit_cite: agādhasaṃśayāmbhodhi samuttaraṇatāriṇīm vande vicitrārthapadāṃ citrāṃ tāṃ gurubhāratīm

plain_english: Having obtained even this unobtainable knowledge treasure placed in the heart cave, by Vasugupta it indeed becomes always auspicious for all worlds.
sanskrit_cite: labdhvāpy alabhyam etaj jñānadhanaṃ hṛdguhāntakṛtanihiteḥ vasuguptavac śivāya hi bhavati sadā sarvalokasya
